description: This Java test class `WebModuleUtilTest` contains unit tests for the `WebModuleUtil` utility class within the OpenMRS project. It tests functionalities related to module startup, servlet loading, and module web folder path resolution, focusing on integration with servlet context and module configuration handling.

classes.description: Unit test class for WebModuleUtil, verifying module startup, servlet loading, and filesystem path functions.
